name: devflow
description: State-based agent development protocol for repository-grounded planning, one-item execution, independent audits, and deterministic handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, execute, audit, and resume agentic development
interface.longDescription: A state-based development protocol that turns an approved PRD into repository-grounded plans and work items, executes one verified change at a time, and performs independent phase and integration audits without repeated handoff prompt authoring.
defaultPrompt: Execute the next DevFlow work item.
